name: PartnerOS
description:
PartnerOS brings AI into every stage of your partner program.

Assess: Score partners with enriched AI data to ensure they fit your ideal partner profile.

Recruit:  Generate a partner recruitment deck tailored to a specific strategic partner, so outreach starts with a pitch built for the right audience.

Enable: Build enablement trainings with Voice AI, then track certifications, training progress, and services engagements as partners move through them.

Register & Track: Register deals seamlessly through AI.

Co-Market: Launch co-marketing initiatives with AI-driven workflows that move campaigns from proposal to completion without manual chasing.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PartnerOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PartnerOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.partneros.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PartnerOS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PartnerOS lists 42 MCP tools, including assess_artifact, create_action_item, create_lead, create_opportunity, create_partner, draft_partner_email, draft_variants, edit_icp, edit_ipp, edit_opportunity, edit_pitch_slide, and enroll_partner.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PartnerOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PartnerOS in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
PartnerOS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PartnerOS is developed by PartnerOS, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
